hero.subtitle: Years of dedication to study abroad education, trusted by students for our expertise and integrity

background.title: Our Background
background.description: Founded in 2020, Huateng Education is a premium and professional study abroad education group. The group specializes in undergraduate and postgraduate study abroad applications, with particularly deep expertise and an outstanding reputation in Hong Kong bachelor's degree admissions. Over the years, Huateng Education has consistently upheld a student-centered service philosophy, helping over 100 students successfully enter the world's top universities, with acceptance rates consistently leading the industry.

visionMission.title: Vision & Mission
visionMission.intro: Since its founding, Huateng Education has regarded "empowering students" as its foundation. We have cultivated deep expertise in education, assembling a team of senior study abroad consultants, overseas returnee scholars, and international course instructors. They are not only industry experts but also individuals who have walked this path themselves, deeply understanding every challenge and aspiration along the educational journey.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To become the world's leading study abroad education service group, building bridges to prestigious universities for students around the globe.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To help every student achieve their dream of attending a prestigious university, providing the most professional and caring academic planning and application services.

team.title: Leadership Team
team.subtitle: An experienced leadership team guiding the group's development

members.name: Liu Hualun
members.bio: Deeply engaged in the education field of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, with many years of experience in education industry management. Founded Huateng Education in 2018, leading the team from scratch to steadily develop into a comprehensive education service institution focusing on cross-border academic advancement. Graduated from Hong Kong Baptist University with a major in Finance, relying on a solid academic foundation, he has long been deeply engaged in Hong Kong and overseas study services. With years of experience in the industry, he has gained profound insights into the serious policy information gap and resource asymmetry between the Mainland and Hong Kong. To break down industry information barriers and avoid fragmented consulting chaos, he established a standardized, transparent one-stop cross-border education service system. Under his overall operation, the institution's core business covers partner institution academic consulting services, and diversified professional academic services including full-stage application planning from primary and secondary schools to doctoral programs at home and abroad.

members.name: Liu Huajing
members.bio: Has many years of experience in study abroad consulting and operations management. Led the establishment of Huateng Education's standardized service system and institutional operations management framework, driving continuous improvement in service quality.

members.name: Demi Deng
members.bio: With a solid Hong Kong local education background, she has been deeply engaged in the Hong Kong higher education field for many years, specializing in all-stage institution applications and document writing. She has helped nearly 100 students gain admission to Hong Kong institutions, excels at customizing personalized study plans based on student backgrounds, carefully manages the entire application process, and communicates professionally and patiently.

members.name: Robert Wong
members.role: Hong Kong International System Specialist Consultant
members.bio: Hong Kong native, LPDF certified career planner, with 8 years of experience in Hong Kong international system planning. Specializes in A-Level course selection planning and Hong Kong institution academic progression, providing one-on-one follow-up throughout the process to offer reliable academic guidance for international system students.
